question: Article 126 of the Indian Constitution mentions ____.

options.text: Appointment of acting Chief Justice of India
Supreme Court to be a court of record

solution:
The correct answer is __**Appointment of the acting Chief Justice of India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Article 126** of the **Indian Constitution** provides for the **Appointment of the acting Chief Justice of India** in the Supreme Court of India.
 
• Appointment of acting Chief Justice of India when there is a lack of quorum of judges available to hold or continue the session of the Supreme Court.
 
• The Chief Justice of India (CJI) has the authority to appoint a judge from a High Court as an ad hoc judge of the Supreme Court after consulting with the President of India and the Chief Justice of the concerned High Court.
 
• These appointments are made on a temporary basis to ensure the smooth functioning of the judiciary and to handle the backlog of cases.
